title: stellaria palustris var. caespitosa
intro: Stellaria palustris var. caespitosa, commonly known as marsh starwort, is a plant species that belongs to the Primulaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, helping to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Stellaria palustris var. caespitosa include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
